post.description: Deletes the server-side session and clears the cookies. Requires the CSRF header.
Sends a single-use sign-in link (valid 15 minutes) to the e-mail address. The answer is the same for known and unknown addresses. Limited per e-mail and per IP.

Consumes the token (single use) and starts a session: sets `daas_session` (HttpOnly) and `daas_csrf`. The first sign-in creates the user. Pending invitations for the address are accepted.

Login-CSRF protection: `POST /auth/magic-link` sets an HttpOnly cookie (`__Host-daas_ml`) in the browser that asked for the link. If the cookie does not match the link (another browser, a cleared cookie, a link someone else planted), the answer is `409 confirm_required` with a masked `email_hint` and the token is NOT consumed; repeat the request with `confirm: true` after the user explicitly agrees to sign in as that address in this browser.

401.description: Token unknown, expired or already used

409.description: `confirm_required`: link was requested from another browser

post.summary: Exchange a sign-in link for a session

The caller, their organizations and roles. For an API key: the key's organization and scopes.

post.description: Creates an organization with the signed-in user as owner. `dpa_accepted` must be `true`: the data processing agreement (DPA) version `v1` is accepted at creation. Needs a user session.

403.description: Not a user session, or selfhost mode

delete.description: Deletes the organization, its control-plane records and its data directory. Refused while jobs are queued or running, and for the selfhost `default` organization.

patch.description: Name, locale, upload retention (days) and the opt-in for LLM-generated summaries.

get.description: Metadata only: the key value is never returned after creation.

schema.title: Response List Keys Api V1 Orgs  Org Id  Api Keys Get

post.description: Returns the key once. Store it in a secret manager; only its hash is kept. A caller can grant only scopes it holds itself.

403.description: Requested scope exceeds the caller's own

delete.description: Takes effect immediately. Revoking an already revoked key succeeds.

get.description: Events of this organization only, ordered by `(ts, id)` descending. Pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` to get the next page; `next_cursor` is `null` on the last page. `meta` holds allow-listed fields only (never file names, e-mail addresses or keys).

422.description: Malformed cursor or limit out of range

get.description: Control -> requirement -> status -> artifact (source and SHA-256) from the latest successful `uksc_evidence` run. `run_status` is `SUCCESS` or `PARTIAL` (an incomplete package). Artifact contents are not returned.
get.summary: Artifact status of the latest collector run

schema.title: Response List Invitations Api V1 Orgs  Org Id  Invitations Get

post.description: Stores an invitation (valid 7 days) and e-mails the address; it is accepted when the address signs in. The answer is always `202 {"status": "accepted"}`: it does not reveal whether the address already has an account or is already a member (nothing is sent in that case). Repeating it for the same address refreshes the invitation. Limits: 20 per organization per 24 hours and 5 per minute per caller (`429 invitation_limit`). Use `GET /invitations` to list and `DELETE` to revoke.

delete.description: Deletes a pending invitation; an accepted one cannot be revoked (remove the member instead).

post.description: Queues a pipeline run and answers `202 Accepted` with a `Location` header. Follow progress with `GET .../jobs/{job_id}` or the SSE stream `.../events`. One run per organization at a time.

422.description: Pipeline and upload do not match

post.description: Only `queued` jobs can be cancelled; a running job finishes.

409.description: The job already started or finished

get.description: `text/event-stream`. Events: `status` (job snapshot on every status change), `progress` (`{id, progress}`), `log` (`{id, message, ts}`) and a final `done` (job snapshot); the stream closes after `done`. A comment line `: heartbeat` is sent every 15 seconds of silence. Limits: 5 open streams per caller and 100 in total (`429 sse_limit`); a stream lives at most 30 minutes (reconnect; the first event of a stream is always a full `status` snapshot).

schema.title: Response List Members Api V1 Orgs  Org Id  Members Get

delete.description: Owners and admins (and keys with `members:manage`) can remove members; only an owner session can remove an owner. The last owner cannot be removed (`409 last_owner`). The member's sessions in this organization end and the API keys they created here are revoked.

403.description: Not allowed to remove an owner

409.description: The last owner cannot be removed

patch.description: Owner sessions only. The last owner cannot be demoted (`409 last_owner`).

409.description: The last owner cannot be demoted

get.description: Run record with report hashes, links and summary metrics. Report paths and raw error text are never returned.

`fmt=html|md|json`. Sent with a restrictive `Content-Security-Policy`, `nosniff`, `ETag` = SHA-256 of the file and `Cache-Control: private, no-store`. Embed the HTML only in a sandboxed iframe. `410 report_expired` once the retention job removed the files (the run record and hashes stay).

Weekly export reminder, auto-run after upload, the e-mail and the chat message when a run finishes. An organization that never saved its schedule gets the defaults (`updated_at: null`). The chat webhook address is never returned: `notify_webhook_set` and the masked `notify_webhook_hint` say whether and which one is saved.

put.description: Replaces the whole schedule (an omitted field takes its default), except `notify_webhook_url`: omitted = unchanged, `null` = remove, text = set (https, public address, no credentials). `reminder_weekday` 0-6 (0 = Monday), `reminder_hour` 0-23 in `timezone` (IANA name); an invalid value answers `422 validation_error` naming the field. `next_reminder_at` is recomputed on every save.

422.description: Invalid weekday, hour, time zone or chat webhook address

post.description: Accepts a CSV or XLSX export (up to 10 MiB, XLSX with container, macro, sheet and row limits) or a collector package (`.json`, up to 5 MiB, validated against the collector schema). Returns the file id and, for CSV/XLSX, the detected column mapping. A workbook with several sheets needs `sheet`.

get.description: Runs and uploaded bytes for the current calendar month (UTC) and the previous one, the limits of the organization's plan (`null` = unlimited) and its upload retention. When a limit is reached, `POST .../jobs` and `POST .../uploads` answer `429` with code `plan_limit`.

post.description: Tells whether a SHA-256 belongs to a report of this organization. The answer never contains report content.

get.description: The signing secret is never returned after creation.

schema.title: Response List Webhooks Api V1 Orgs  Org Id  Webhooks Get

post.description: Registers an HTTPS endpoint for `run.finished`. The response carries the signing secret once; every delivery has `X-DaaS-Signature: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256(secret, body)>`, `X-DaaS-Event`, `X-DaaS-Delivery` and `X-DaaS-Timestamp`. Non-public addresses are refused outside dev. A delivery is attempted up to 3 times (back-off from `DAAS_WEBHOOK_BACKOFF_SEC`), redirects are not followed.

409.description: Duplicate URL or webhook limit reached

post.description: Sends one signed `ping` event (single attempt) and reports whether the endpoint answered 2xx and the class of its answer (`status_class`); the exact status code is not returned.
